*** Add File: translation_models.py
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Union
+
+
+TextLike = Union[str, Sequence[str]]
+
+
+def _to_list(value: TextLike) -> List[str]:
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        return [value]
+    return [str(item) for item in value]
+
+
+def _compact_dict(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {k: v for k, v in data.items() if v is not None}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationRequest:
+    text: TextLike
+    target_language: str
+    source_language: Optional[str] = None
+    format: Optional[str] = None
+    model: Optional[str] = None
+    options: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def normalized(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+            "text": _to_list(self.text),
+            "target_language": self.target_language,
+            "source_language": self.source_language,
+            "format": self.format,
+            "model": self.model,
+        }
+        if self.options:
+            payload["options"] = dict(self.options)
+        return _compact_dict(payload)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationResult:
+    text: str
+    detected_source_language: Optional[str] = None
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_payload(cls, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "TranslationResult":
+        text = payload.get("text")
+        if isinstance(text, list):
+            text = text[0] if text else ""
+        return cls(
+            text=str(text or ""),
+            detected_source_language=payload.get("detected_source_language"),
+            confidence=payload.get("confidence"),
+            raw=dict(payload),
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationResponse:
+    translations: List[TranslationResult]
+    model: Optional[str] = None
+    usage: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    raw: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_payload(cls, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> "TranslationResponse":
+        items = payload.get("translations") or payload.get("data") or []
+        translations = [
+            TranslationResult.from_payload(item) if isinstance(item, Mapping) else TranslationResult(text=str(item))
+            for item in items
+        ]
+        usage = payload.get("usage") or {}
+        return cls(
+            translations=translations,
+            model=payload.get("model"),
+            usage=dict(usage) if isinstance(usage, Mapping) else {},
+            raw=dict(payload),
+        )
+
+
+def normalize_translation_request(data: Union[TranslationRequest, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(data, TranslationRequest):
+        return data.normalized()
+    text = data.get("text")
+    if text is None:
+        raise ValueError("translation request requires 'text'")
+    return TranslationRequest(
+        text=text,
+        target_language=str(data.get("target_language") or data.get("targetLanguage") or ""),
+        source_language=data.get("source_language") or data.get("sourceLanguage"),
+        format=data.get("format"),
+        model=data.get("model"),
+        options=dict(data.get("options") or {}),
+    ).normalized()
+
+
+def normalize_translation_response(data: Union[TranslationResponse, Mapping[str, Any]]) -> TranslationResponse:
+    if isinstance(data, TranslationResponse):
+        return data
+    return TranslationResponse.from_payload(data)
*** End Patch

+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_MODEL = os.getenv("TRANSLATION_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")
+DEFAULT_SOURCE_LANG = os.getenv("TRANSLATION_SOURCE_LANGUAGE", "auto")
+DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG = os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE", "en")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
+    source_language: str = DEFAULT_SOURCE_LANG
+    target_language: str = DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG
+    temperature: float = 0.0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls) -> "TranslationConfig":
+        return cls(
+            api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
+            base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
+            model=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL),
+            source_language=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_SOURCE_LANGUAGE", DEFAULT_SOURCE_LANG),
+            target_language=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE", DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG),
+            temperature=float(os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TEMPERATURE", "0")),
+        )
+
+
+class TranslationClient:
+    def __init__(self, config: Optional[TranslationConfig] = None) -> None:
+        self.config = config or TranslationConfig.from_env()
+        self.client = OpenAI(api_key=self.config.api_key, base_url=self.config.base_url)
+
+    def translate_text(
+        self,
+        text: str,
+        source_language: Optional[str] = None,
+        target_language: Optional[str] = None,
+        model: Optional[str] = None,
+        extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+    ) -> str:
+        if not text:
+            return ""
+
+        response = self.client.responses.create(
+            model=model or self.config.model,
+            input=[
+                {
+                    "role": "system",
+                    "content": (
+                        "You are a precise translation engine. "
+                        "Translate the user's text faithfully without adding explanations."
+                    ),
+                },
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": (
+                        f"Source language: {source_language or self.config.source_language}\n"
+                        f"Target language: {target_language or self.config.target_language}\n"
+                        f"Text:\n{text}"
+                    ),
+                },
+            ],
+            temperature=self.config.temperature,
+            **(extra or {}),
+        )
+        return getattr(response, "output_text", "").strip()
+
+
+def get_translation_config() -> TranslationConfig:
+    return TranslationConfig.from_env()
+
+
+def get_translation_client() -> TranslationClient:
+    return TranslationClient()
+
+
+def translate_text(
+    text: str,
+    source_language: Optional[str] = None,
+    target_language: Optional[str] = None,
+    model: Optional[str] = None,
+    extra: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+) -> str:
+    return get_translation_client().translate_text(
+        text=text,
+        source_language=source_language,
+        target_language=target_language,
+        model=model,
+        extra=extra,
+    )

+

+
+

+DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG = os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE", "en")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TranslationConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None

+    target_language: str = DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG
+    temperature: float = 0.0

+            model=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL),
+            source_language=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_SOURCE_LANGUAGE", DEFAULT_SOURCE_LANG),
+            target_language=os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TARGET_LANGUAGE", DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG),
+            temperature=float(os.getenv("TRANSLATION_TEMPERATURE", "0")),
+        )
